# Rudis — Financing Readiness Checklist

**Purpose:** prepare Rudis for serious strategic financing without overstating maturity or weakening founder autonomy.

## A. Corporate / contracting readiness

- [ ] Identify the legal person that will sign the financing / R&D agreement.
- [ ] Confirm tax residence and accounting setup.
- [ ] Establish project bank account / treasury controls where required.
- [ ] Define founder role and authority in the contracting vehicle.
- [ ] Define how existing founder-held IP is licensed or transferred, if at all.
- [ ] Avoid representing a future entity as owner before valid transfer/license exists.

## B. IP / chain of title

- [ ] Public AGPL scope mapped.
- [ ] Documentation / Corpus rights mapped.
- [ ] Brand / trademark assets mapped.
- [ ] Private implementation assets inventoried.
- [ ] Material contributor rights verified.
- [ ] Third-party components and licenses inventoried.
- [ ] Any incompatible / unclear material placed on HOLD for commercial claims.
- [ ] External precedents recorded without unsupported ownership claims.

## C. Security / disclosure

- [ ] Public-repository publication pre-flight complete.
- [ ] Historical metadata residuals tracked.
- [ ] No known public credentials / tokens / private keys.
- [ ] NDA data-room levels defined.
- [ ] Restricted review protocol defined.
- [ ] Vulnerability disclosure path defined.
- [ ] Exact private candidate data never made public by default.

## D. Technical diligence

- [ ] Current PRE-D3 status stated accurately.
- [ ] Exact candidate can be frozen internally.
- [ ] Reproducibility evidence available or open limitation stated.
- [ ] Known FAIL / HOLD register current.
- [ ] Independent review responsibilities defined.
- [ ] Demo does not imply production readiness.
- [ ] Claims map to evidence handles or public evidence.

## E. Commercial model

- [ ] Strategic R&D proposal prepared.
- [ ] Initial USD 12M staged structure prepared.
- [ ] Optional later USD 15M field program clearly non-automatic.
- [ ] Revenue hypotheses separated from forecasts.
- [ ] Commercial rights that can legally be offered identified.
- [ ] No promise of exclusivity beyond rights actually held.

## F. Founder autonomy

- [ ] Founder Strategic Reserve included in negotiation baseline.
- [ ] Target reserve: not less than 10% of each funded tranche.
- [ ] Founder can make ordinary operating/research decisions without transaction-level partner approval.
- [ ] Founder liquidity / compensation is negotiated transparently and separately from project OPEX.
- [ ] No blanket assignment of present/future founder IP.
- [ ] No broad personal non-compete by default.
- [ ] No disproportionate personal guarantees.
- [ ] Unrelated future founder projects remain free unless a narrowly defined conflict is agreed.

## G. Budget / controls

- [ ] Phase budget exists.
- [ ] Founder Strategic Reserve is separately visible.
- [ ] Founder compensation / liquidity structure is separately visible.
- [ ] Management may rebalance ordinary categories within an agreed variance band.
- [ ] Reporting is aggregate enough to avoid micromanagement but sufficient for legitimate accountability.
- [ ] Related-party transactions have a clear threshold / approval rule.

## H. Partner rights

- [ ] Internal evaluation rights defined.
- [ ] NDA / confidentiality defined.
- [ ] Technical access purpose-bound.
- [ ] Commercial negotiation rights time-limited.
- [ ] ROFN preferred to broad ROFR.
- [ ] Exclusivity, if any, field-limited, time-limited and separately compensated.
- [ ] Partner does not gain Rudis constitutional authority through funding.

## I. Legal / regulatory work before signing

- [ ] Spanish / applicable corporate counsel reviews structure.
- [ ] Tax adviser reviews founder compensation / liquidity / reserve mechanics.
- [ ] IP counsel or competent lawyer reviews chain of title and licensing.
- [ ] Data-protection review completed for shared data.
- [ ] Financial-services / RU concepts explicitly excluded from real operation unless separately authorized and licensed.
- [ ] Securities-law characterization reviewed if equity / convertible instrument is used.

## J. Outreach assets

- [x] Public one-pager.
- [x] RAL Public Architecture Brief.
- [x] Maturity & Limits Statement.
- [x] Sanitized Security Posture.
- [x] Disclosure Classification Matrix.
- [x] Demo Release Checklist.
- [x] IP / License / Provenance public matrix.
- [x] Meta NDA Data Room Index.
- [x] Restricted Review Protocol.
- [x] Financing Principles & Founder Autonomy Framework.
- [x] Strategic Financing Term Sheet Framework.
- [ ] 8–10 slide investor / strategic-partner deck.
- [ ] 90–180 second sanitized demo video.
- [ ] founder / project professional contact channel independent of compromised social accounts.
- [ ] target list and outreach tracker.

## K. Release gate

Do not enter binding financing until the unresolved items that materially affect the transaction are either closed or expressly disclosed as conditions.

```text
CLEAN ENOUGH TO DILIGENCE
!=
EVERYTHING FINISHED
```

The objective is not to eliminate uncertainty; it is to make uncertainty legible, bounded and negotiable.
